reviewer: Claude continuation session (took over the uncommitted Codex draft)
scope: Uncommitted Codex 16.3A draft against the canonical master-order 16.3A field list and the 16.3 validation contract it consumes.

findings.summary: A fulfillment sample's deliverable and rights evidence were bound to the sample artifact but not to the deliverable's capability, so a LOCAL_DELIVERABLE_PROOF record scoped to another capability could prove this deliverable.
findings.reproduced: P51 (split deliverable/rights records, each scoped to video.render) returned OWNER_REVIEW_READY before the fix.
findings.fix: Both evidence predicates now require capabilityKey to be null or equal to the deliverable's capability.
regression: negative controls: deliverable/rights evidence capability binding dropped

findings.summary: The draft passed a JSON depth of 12 to isAyasRevenueBoundedJson, whose parameter type is the revenue-wide literal 8; npx tsc --noEmit failed with three TS2345 errors.
findings.reproduced: tsc exit 2 on the inherited draft.
findings.fix: Use the canonical revenue depth limit (default). The deepest path in the offer input is 6 levels, so no valid input is refused.

observationsNotDefects: Platform mappings to platforms other than the validated opportunity platform yield OWNER_REVIEW_READY with reason LOCAL_OFFER_REQUIRES_OWNER_AND_PLATFORM_REVALIDATION. Revalidation per platform is enforced later (16.4-16.8 adapters, 16.12 pilot, 16.13 'new platform => new validation').

Several guards were only covered transitively (status, rights and deliverable dimensions; capability scope; accepted-evidence membership; portfolio identity; slowest-sample choice). Primary cases P52-P59 now isolate each one, and each has an assertion-caught negative control.
